questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 09 Question 1: How does the time period of a simple pendulum change if the length of the string is increased fourfold in a constant gravitational field?
questions.solution: Time period T = 2*pi*sqrt(L / g). When L -> 4L, T -> sqrt(4)*T = 2T.
